scope: Exact Fraction arithmetic and outward square-root/logarithm enclosures certify the base and scalar constants in the P_61 physical-entropy moat. The Boolean regression checks the exact nonnegative entropy-density formula through n=4489. Together with the published Chebyshev bound psi(x)>=0.9x for x>=41 and the algebra in L-91682, this proves that every P_61 one-prime causal signed row with p>=67 and 1<=y<67 has literal physical entropy exceeding its signed declared score by more than 1/2. It does not prove the target/row determinants, the finite causal profile corridor, the root equality realization, or RH.
